github.lead: Beyondia keeps its tools in a public GitHub organization. Every repository is listed here with what it is for.

repos.name: Beyond-Sales
repos.description: A local business-to-business outreach platform: a mail queue, a company-website scraper, automated sending with safety limits, and tracking of replies and leads, with AI-assisted drafting.

repos.name: Beyond-Bot-Bybit
repos.description: A .NET console application that automates trading on Bybit: pluggable strategies, indicators, order management and MySQL storage, built to run as a service on Linux.

repos.name: Beyond-Website
repos.description: This website. The home page and this page are generated from one config file by the site manager.

repos.name: Gymtronic
